rfa.title: RFA — Request for Approval
rfa.summary: Documents that used to circulate by hand are now approved online, with automatic reminders.
wins: No more random logouts in the middle of approving
Documents open right in the browser, no downloads
Approvals can be delegated when someone is away
problems: ASP.NET Session expired unexpectedly during approvals
Approvers had to download files to read them
One role per user, no delegation
solutions: Migrated to OWIN cookie auth with configurable expiration
AWS S3 storage + Office Live in-browser preview
RBAC with multiple roles per user & delegation
